 Valencia vs Real Madrid, 2026 La Liga: Predicted lineups
 by Lucas Navarrete Nov 7, 2026, 7:23 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid visit Valencia and both Arda Güler and Aurelien Tchouameni are back with the team after missing Wednesday’s match in Athens. Valencia have been struggling all season long but this away game is always a tough one for Los Blancos, who will need to play with intensity and physicality if they want to earn the three points.
 PREDICTED LINEUPS 
 Valencia predicted XI: Dimitrievski; Maffeo, Arnau, Tárrega, Pepelu, Gayá; Mayol, Guido, Guerra, Danjuma; Sadiq.
 Real Madrid predicted XI: Courtois; Valverde, Konaté, Huijsen, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Bernardo; Güler, Bellingham, Diomande; Mbappé.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGA 
 Date : 11/07/2026
 Time : 21:00 CET, 03:00pm EST.
 Venue : Mestalla, Valencia, Spain.
 Available TV : DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).
 Available Streaming : ESPN+ (USA)
